name: The Maintenance Tunnels
hours: Staff only; Silas Grieve walks them on Mondays. Students know three ways in and pretend to know six.
sight: Brick-vaulted service tunnels run under the whole campus, warm and dim, lined with lagged steam pipes and bundled holo-cable. Bare bulbs in cages make a chain of yellow islands. Painted arrows point to ARENA, DOMES, LIBRARY, KITCHEN; older arrows underneath have been painted out. Water drips somewhere with great patience, and the walls sweat.
things: Follow the arrows and learn which hatch comes up where
Find the graffiti of every graduating class, the old ones in four colours
Take the shortcut to the arena stage hatch
Listen at a grating to a room above
Follow a painted-out arrow to a bricked-up arch
Get lost for a slot and come up somewhere embarrassing
Find the disused meter room that somebody has fitted out as a photographic darkroom
Meet someone else who should not be down here
secret: The stealth layer of the campus: links main building, library (and the Archive's service door), arena stage, Trial Domes, cafeteria kitchen and the infirmary cellar. After D67 this is how to move at night. The painted-out arrows read UMBRA: a tunnel once ran north under the ridge to the fourth dorm; it is bricked up 200 metres in, but the brick is one course thick and recent mortar shows it was opened and re-closed within the last year (Viktor). Under the Trial Domes lies the hologram plant, Professor Helical's real workplace most nights; at its far end the bypassed original projector stands in a sealed grey housing with a second, private padlock and a small chalk helix on the plate (the second grey notebook; plot file, M9). The plantation built on older cuttings: in the deepest stretch the wall changes from brick to fitted black stone with small square recesses — Tessellate work, the southernmost trace of it. Silas knows every metre and will guide someone he trusts. The darkroom in the old meter room is Pippa's; it is turned over around Day 70 unless she has hidden her negatives. '{H}' is met down here exactly once, standing in the dark without a lamp, 'listening'.
access: Forbidden to students. Entrances: boiler room behind the cafeteria, the arena stage hatch, a grating by the clock tower arcade (viktor, tomi and silas know them).
